messages:
Ivy: Quick check on the vectors preview + export modal. Figma: https://figma.com/file/efgh
Ivy: Key items: export split behavior, truncation policy, filename UX, and accessibility labels.
Marco - Eng: Backend can split into multiple files (10k rows/file) and zip. Gzip each part optional. We should stream to avoid blocking UI.
Zoe (PM): Default behavior: export full text, but warn on huge cells. Add checkbox: 'Truncate long fields in export' (off by default).
Harper - A11y: Modal must trap focus, export progress announced via aria-live, and the "rows selected" indicator needs SR-friendly text. Color contrast for the part badge is low.
Ivy: Copy options for header: 1) "Export embeddings (CSV | JSONL) — includes id & values." 2) "Download vector rows — choose columns & format." Preferences?
Zoe (PM): Lean 1 for clarity. Also include docs link in small type.
Marco - Eng: We'll expose rerank metadata toggle to include columns: rerank_rank, rerank_score. Easy to add.
Ivy: Show estimated file size live when toggling format/columns. Filename preview should be editable; append .partN for splits.
Harper - A11y: Tooltips must be keyboard focusable and dismissible with ESC. Ensure aria-describedby IDs for limit text.
Ivy: Final asks: confirm header copy (1), default rerank toggle (off), show estimate, and include aria IDs. I'll update figma and follow up.
Zoe (PM): Confirmed: header 1, rerank off by default, docs link included. Prioritize a11y for sprint.
